interpretation.additional_refs_worktrees: Listed separately; existence after baseline alone does not establish creation time, ownership or authorization, and does not change protected preservation result.
interpretation.concurrency: Metadata captured sequentially during active task work; no repository lock or atomic global snapshot imposed to avoid interference. Protected data comparison is against the captured current metadata.
interpretation.path_existence_result: all original registered paths exist as directories
interpretation.preexisting_distinction: Original snapshot HEAD/branch/detached/path/flags compared exactly. A difference is labeled preexisting only if the original snapshot itself contains it; no unsupported timing inference.

scope: Read-only shared Git metadata and original protected path existence only; no status scans, user content reads, checkout/edit/delete/prune or cleanup.
